title: Freight Damage Report Form
subtitle: Freight Damage: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Freight Damage Report Form covers freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action. The freight exception coordinator records Freight Damage chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Freight Damage Report Form keeps Freight Damage exceptions visible until the freight exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Damage Report Form at trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area. Document freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action identity before Freight Damage begins. Compare freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action findings with stated Freight Damage criteria; route unresolved Freight Damage issues to claims or cargo-condition reviewer. For Freight Damage Report Form, confirm requirements for Freight Damage. Ask claims or cargo-condition reviewer to review Freight Damage conditions beyond the freight exception coordinator's role.

Protect freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action; document the Freight Damage notification and await claims or cargo-condition reviewer direction.
